sources.title: Information Acquisition in Matching Markets: The Role of Price Discovery
sources.notes: Inspected author PDF is dated June 16, 2020. SSRN record 3705049, DOI 10.2139/ssrn.3705049, instead describes an October 5, 2020 manuscript posted November 23; keep version dates distinct.

sources.title: Costly information acquisition in centralized matching markets
sources.notes: Publisher full text opened during initial evidence work. The author-hosted PDF opened for section modeling is an earlier 57-page manuscript dated July 19, 2021, not the 2023 version of record. Crossref corroborates journal metadata.

sources.title: FairRec: Two-Sided Fairness for Personalized Recommendations in Two-Sided Platforms

sources.title: Managing Congestion in a Matching Market via Demand Information Disclosure
sources.notes: Publisher abstract and metadata inspected, plus publisher-deposited Crossref page range. PDF endpoint is publisher-advertised; access to complete PDF was not established. Claims limited to abstract-supported experiment and qualitative findings.

sources.title: Gender Differences in Mate Selection: Evidence From a Speed Dating Experiment
sources.notes: Publisher metadata and Columbia-hosted original paper inspected, including scorecard timing and 14-session estimation sample versus 21 total sessions.

sources.title: College Admissions and the Stability of Marriage
sources.notes: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata checked; publisher browser endpoint returned 403. Original 7-page paper scan opened on university host but yielded no text; no full-text analytical inspection claimed. Also associated with archival identifier 10.2307/2312726.

sources.title: What price stability? Social welfare in matching markets
sources.notes: Publisher abstract/record returned through search; direct browser fetch was 403. Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata verified. Opened PDF is an earlier 2011 working-paper/conference submission, not the 2014 version of record.

sources.title: Anarchy, stability, and utopia: creating better matchings
sources.notes: Publisher abstract explicitly establishes prior work on arbitrarily bad welfare loss under general preferences. Metadata checked with publisher page and Crossref. Old author PDF URL redirected to department home page, so no usable open full-text link is asserted. Distinct conference predecessor: SAGT 2009, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-04645-2_15, pp. 159–170.
